description: This PHP source file defines the TranslateProjectDashboardController class within the Goteo application, specifically handling translation management for various project components including overview, costs, rewards, supports, updates, and story in the dashboard. It contains methods for validating projects, creating forms, handling translation actions, and saving translations for different project sections.

classes.name: TranslateProjectDashboardController
classes.description: Controller class managing translation operations for project sections in the Goteo dashboard.

methods.name: validateProject
methods.description: Validates project existence and permissions, retrieves relevant data for translations, and prepares view data.

methods.name: createFormBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a form builder instance, defaulting to specific attributes.

methods.name: translateAction
methods.description: Main method to display translation overview for a project.

methods.name: overviewTranslateAction
methods.description: Handles translation form for project overview section.

methods.name: costsTranslateAction
methods.description: Handles translation editing for project costs.

methods.name: rewardsTranslateAction
methods.description: Provides translation editing for project rewards, both individual and social.

methods.name: supportsTranslateAction
methods.description: Handles translation updates for project supports.

methods.name: updatesTranslateAction
methods.description: Allows translation editing for project updates/blog posts.

methods.name: storyTranslateAction
methods.description: Provides translation handling for project story.
